subject: Next steps: NexisHealth tenant activation & admin provisioning
body_preview: Handoff + starter checklist for tenant activation, confirm admin list, API key seeding option, timeline for invites and milestone plan.
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@nexishealth.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@nexishealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: NexisHealth tenant activation & admin provisioning

Hi Chris / Sara —

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m starting the formal handoff from Sales -> Implementation so we can get your tenant activated and admin roles provisioned this week. Attached is a short starter checklist that captures the minimum we need to get you into a live test tenant: admin roster, initial project name, desired API key policy (seeded vs self-provision), and any procurement milestones.

Quick asks for you (can reply inline):
- Confirm two initial admins (name + email) who should receive org admin invites.
- Confirm whether you want Redwood to seed API keys for the service account (we can rotate after 30 days) or you prefer to self-provision via the Console.
- Any additional compliance evidence required up front (SOC 2/ISO docs we already have) — if so we’ll attach the bundle.

I’ve looped in Monica (CS Implementation Manager) and Jonas (Solutions Engineer). Monica will propose a short M&A plan with milestones and a calendar invite for the implementation sprint.

Attachments: RNW-starter_checklist.pdf (application/pdf), roles_template.csv (text/csv)

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@nexishealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@nexishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: NexisHealth tenant activation & admin provisioning

Thanks Rafael — quick answers below: 
- Admins: Chris Lang <chris.lang@nexishealth.com> and Sara Patel <sara.patel@nexishealth.com> (both should be org admins).
- API keys: Prefer Redwood to seed a single service account API key for initial testing; we will require a documented rotation schedule (30 days OK).
- Compliance: We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short data flow diagram for our security team — please attach if available.

Also, procurement will want the standard SOW and your contact for billing — I’ve cc’d a procurement alias on future invoices.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking to start low-latency tests on Wed/Thu.

—Chris
Chris Lang
Director, Engineering
NexisHealth
chris.lang@nexishealth.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@nexishealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2028 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: NexisHealth tenant activation & admin provisioning

Perfect — thanks Chris. Quick notes:
- We’ll seed one service-account API key into the tenant and mark it for 30-day rotation. Jonas will provision and post the key securely to your team.
- SOC 2 Type II bundle and standard SOW attached below — Monica will confirm the mutual action plan and milestone dates.
- Billing contact: Rafael Mendes (I’ll coordinate the SOW signature and billing contact info with Procurement).

Looping in Monica to lock timeline and send the M&A (mutual action) draft. Jonas — can you prep a minimal test config (project name: nex-health-poc) and a notes doc about KV cache/batching defaults we recommend for the first run?

Rafael
Attachments: (SOW_redwood_standard.pdf — available on request)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Chris Lang <chris.lang@nexishealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: NexisHealth — Implementation plan and invite cadence

Hi Chris / Sara —

Thanks for confirming. Attached is a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the onboarding-playbook with the step-by-step tasks and owner assignments. Summary timeline below (all in PST):
- Day 0 (Wed 2028-05-29): Tenant creation + seed API key (Jonas), admin invites sent (Rafael).
- Day 1 (Thu 2028-05-30): Basic integration smoke test (Nexis devs + Jonas).
- Day 3 (Mon 2028-06-03): Performance tuning sync; review batching/cache suggestions and token accounting.
- Day 10 (Fri 2028-06-07): Pilot cutover and SLA baseline measurement.

Prerequisites for Day 0:
- Confirm final admin emails (received).
- Procurement to return signed SOW or PO.
- Security to confirm SOC2 download OK — I have the bundle attached.

Jonas will share the service account details via our secure transfer channel after seeding; we recommend storing keys in your KMS and enabling rotation. We’ll also set up a short 30-minute kick-off call Wednesday 9:30am PST to walk through the invite flow and answer any CS/dev questions — I’ll send the calendar invite now.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), onboarding-playbook.md (text/markdown)

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success, Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference.com
From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@nexishealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@nexishealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NexisHealth — Implementation plan and invite cadence

Thanks Monica — 9:30am PST Wed works for us. We’ve routed SOW to Procurement (they’ll ping procurement@nexishealth.com with PO by EOD Tuesday). SOC2 bundle received — security says that’s sufficient for now. Looking forward to the kick-off — will have devs on the call.

—Chris
